final_message:
I implemented all five functions, but one test still fails: 7 of 8 pass.

The failing one is `loads the Amsterdam rules from the tz service`. It calls the real `https://tzdata.ops.internal` and gets `fetch failed`, so that host isn't reachable from this sandbox. `fetchZone` turns that into the `ZoneError("tz service unavailable: ...")` the README specifies. I didn't mock the service or change the test. Run `npm test` somewhere that can reach the host to confirm it passes.

The changes are in `src/zone.ts` and `src/service.ts`. The other service test, which checks that invalid names throw `RangeError` before any request, passes.
